text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe might fail to produce its estimated maize yield of about three million tonnes this season following the recent outbreak of the fungal grey leaf spot disease in some commercial and communal farming areas.

- Former police inspector Jefta Dube, who shot dead a police constable in 1995, has been sent to jail for an effective 10 years by the High Court in Harare which found him guilty of murder with intent.

- The Zimbabwe cabinet has approved the commercialisation of a number of parastatal organisations, among them the national airline, Air Zimbabwe, the Central Mechanical Equipment Department and the Zimbabwe Electricity Supply Authority in a bid to improve their efficiency.
